scope: Prospective group observation: explicit palm visual >=2048 pixels and each of five finger families >=512 in at least one of three pairwise >=30deg views; base same-rigid >200 each. Every native hand body must reach64 pixels in a selected view; all gaps retained. Three supplementary wide views cover all four arms, both tables and forearm/wrist2 visible pixels. Native27 held bitwise for every render. No full-mesh, occlusion-free, contact-patch, force or physical safety certification.

camera.K_source: actual centered USD focal length/apertures; SDK cross-check

geometry.plane_equation: inward unit normal dot world_point + offset; subtract sphere radius

wide_coverage.scope: visible exact native rigid/table intersections; never complete mesh or contact patch visibility
